completion:
Visit the buildings to perform building accessibility checks
3. Migrate inspection record to the building accessibility check record
4. Document according to the failed building accessibility checks with notation.

OBJECTIVE 1: To perform the visual systems audit and select the correct scope of work (SOW)

## VISUAL SYSTEMS AUDIT
### A-STATUS DISTRIBUTION

A-1. If all visual aids do not work, select:
* [ ] Complete system failure
    * If applicable continue to X-1

A-2. If all visual aids work, select:
* [ ] All systems

A-3. If some visual aids do not work, select:
* [ ] Partial system failure

---

PAGE: 1

### HARDWARE

| BUILDING ACCESSIBILITY CHECK
